title: The Hare and the Tortoise: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: The tortoise says she can race the hare.
The hare lies down under a tree and falls asleep.
The tortoise stops to rest too.
What does the hare say to the tortoise?
Who comes to watch the race?

items.why: “The tortoise moves forward slowly, step by step.”

items.q: Why does the hare stop to rest?
Where is the tortoise when the hare wakes up?
items.why: “The tortoise is almost at the finish line!”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: A fast hare laughed at a slow tortoise, so they had a race. The hare was far ahead, so he lay down under a tree and fell asleep. The tortoise kept going without stopping and won the race.

items.q: Why does the hare lie down under a tree?
items.model: The tortoise is far away, so he thinks he has time to rest.

items.q: What does the tortoise do while the hare is asleep?
items.model: She keeps going. She walks on and on, without stopping.

items.q: What does the tortoise say at the end?
items.model: "Slowly, but without stopping, we move forward."

items.q: Are you more like the hare or the tortoise? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: The hare makes fun of the tortoise
The hare falls asleep under a tree
